messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: 1767894321 - Sentry ingest errors increased: 5xx spike and dropped events. Pager sent to @Irene. auto-escalation level: P1
Irene: Paging in. I'm oncall. seeing spike in Sentry 5xx from our internal error-ingest queue. Multiple customers reporting missing exception signals.
Sam: Confirmed — our error-ingest lambda logs show 502/503 when forwarding to Sentry. Quick check: `curl -I https://sentry.io/api/0/` returns 502.
Irene: I see same. Looking at headers, failures show `x-auth-error: token_issue`. Suspicious. Could be the auth provider.
Mike: FYI Sentry status page shows degraded: https://status.sentry.io/ incidents/abc123 (pasted link)
Anya: I already opened a support ticket with Sentry and linked our request ID. Ticket 78910. Sentry status notes a third-party token issuer (Auth0) is experiencing latency causing token validation timeouts -> ingest rejects.
Irene: Good context. For mitigation we can: 1) enable local fallback buffering so events are queued to S3; 2) short-circuit to minimal internal logging for critical customers; 3) notify impacted customers and CS.
Sam: Working on a quick patch to enable buffering: will flip `FEATURE_SENTRY_BUFFER=true` in prod. Command: `kubectl set env deployment/error-ingest FEATURE_SENTRY_BUFFER=true -n prod`
Paul: I'll stand up a temporary S3 queue consumer to accept events until Sentry recovers. Setting up IAM roles now.
Irene: Anya, can you coordinate customer comms? Need list of customers who had recent spike and potential SLA impact. Query suggestion: `select customer_id from error_events where event_time > now() - interval '15 minutes' and dest='sentry' AND status in ('dropped','5xx')`
Anya: On it. Drafting status: "We are seeing a third-party token issuer issue causing Sentry ingest degradation which may lead to missing exceptions. We're buffering most events and will backfill once Sentry recovers. No data loss expected but delays to event availability." Posting to status page after review.
Mike: I'm going to temporarily lower sampling for non-production orgs to reduce overall token usage: will set `SAMPLING_RATE=0.02` for env=staging via config rollout.
Irene: Good. Also toggle tracing writes off for low-tier to reduce token churn: flip `TRACING_WRITE=false`.
Sam: Patch deployed to enable buffering and sampling changes. Logs show successful local queue writes. Example log: `[info] buffered event id=abc123 size=2KB`
oncall-bot: Incident update: P1 acknowledged by Irene. State: mitigating. Next update in 15m.
Irene: We need to capture proof of missing customer exceptions for postmortem. @Anya please save sample request IDs and customer IDs that show gaps.
Anya: Saved list and alerted CST to expect incoming tickets. Creating a short customer-facing blurb for ops and support.
Paul: S3 buffer is live. Consumer will retry delivery to Sentry every 30s with exponential backoff. Small consumer script ready.
Sam: We got a reply from Sentry support: "We are investigating; root cause appears to be token validation failures from our third-party auth provider. We'll provide ETA in 30-60 mins." (ticket 78910)
Irene: OK continue mitigation. If Sentry recovers we will run backfill script from S3 -> Sentry with dedupe keys attached.
Mike: Do we need to escalate to SLA ops? This might cross our 99.9 ingest acknowledgement window if it persists.
Irene: Yes @Paul please notify ops-sla and include estimated impact window: now -> +2 hours tentative.
Paul: Notified ops-sla with mitigation steps and backfill plan.
oncall-bot: Incident update: 30m elapsed. State: mitigating. Sentry status updated: investigating third-party token issuer. Keeping P1.
Sam: small follow-up: we may see duplicate events after backfill; consumer will attach original `event_id` and our ingest route will dedupe on `SENTRY_EVENT_ID`.
Irene: Documented backfill procedure in the incident doc. Also tracking metrics: `missing_event_count` and `backfilled_count`.
Anya: Customer comm posted to https://status.redwood.ai: "We're buffering errors for delivery; no new errors will be lost. We'll update when backfill completes."
Mike: 45m — Sentry reports partial recovery: token issuer improved; 5xx rates declining. They suggest queued events will be accepted now.
Sam: Starting backfill process from S3 to Sentry. Running with rate limit 100 rps to avoid causing extra load.
Paul: Backfill script started. Monitor logs: `backfill: ok event=abc123 -> 200`
Irene: I'll prepare a handoff to night oncall in case this resurfaces. Handoff summary: cause = third-party token issuer latency causing Sentry ingest 5xx/drops; mitigation = enabled local buffering, lowered sampling, started backfill; customer comms posted; ticket with Sentry open 78910. Estimated residual risk: low.
oncall-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 2025-11-12T02:00Z to @Mike
Irene: Thanks team. @Sam please leave the buffer flag on until backfill complete and we see 2h of stable 200s to Sentry. I'll follow up tomorrow for postmortem.
Sam: Will do. Current backfill progress ~85% done per consumer logs.
Anya: CST scaled up on standby. No high-severity customer escalations yet.
Mike: Taking handoff. Leaving channel open for any surprises.
Irene: End of active triage. Closing active page but leaving incident open for followup/postmortem. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident state: monitored -> on-call handoff completed. Last update 1767901800
